templates.name: 黑白线稿转彩色真人跳舞
templates.name_en: Black-and-white line art to colored real-human dancing
templates.description: 黑白人物线稿逐帧上色，线稿变为真实人物跳舞
templates.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced. Preserve the exact facial identity, hairstyle, and clothing of the figure from the reference image.

integrated_multimodal_description: [镜头1]【0-3秒】画面呈现竖构图，背景保持输入线稿画面的纯净空间，光线柔和均匀。画面中央是一个清晰的黑色线稿人物轮廓，线条流畅简洁。随着时间推移，线稿表面开始泛起微光，黑色线条逐渐填充上真实的皮肤质感与衣物色彩，呈现出从线稿到真实人物的平滑过渡。人物姿态由静止的站立姿势开始微微舒展，周围空气中似乎有细微的光尘漂浮，营造出梦幻而精致的氛围。电影级画质，轮廓清晰:1.5，光影细腻，景深适中。[镜头2] 在00:03.000【3-6秒】，镜头保持固定机位，完全实体化的真实人物开始在画面中跳舞。人物形象、发型、服装与线稿所对应的人物保持一致，不被改变。【ACTION】人物动作轻盈流畅，双臂优雅地挥动，身体随着节奏摆动，衣摆随之飘动，舞蹈动作带动周围空气与光线流动。舞蹈动作充满韵律感，展现出活力与自信。【/ACTION】整体画面唯美，视觉焦点完全集中在人物的舞蹈表现上，色彩从线稿的黑白灰过渡到柔和的自然彩色色调。

overall_soundscape: 起始阶段伴随轻微的魔法般的闪烁音效和空气流动声，随后过渡到清晰、有节奏感的脚步声和衣物摩擦声，伴随着人物舞蹈时的呼吸声，整体氛围轻快而富有韵律。

non_diegetic_music: 一段现代简约的电子背景音乐，节奏轻快明快，带有轻微的合成器音色，旋律简单重复，与舞蹈动作同步，营造出时尚且充满活力的氛围。

templates.name: 线稿转真人行走
templates.description: 黑白线稿逐步上色为真实人物，从静止到自然行走
templates.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-3s] The frame opens in portrait composition. The background is a clean white space with soft, even lighting. At center frame is a clear black line-art human figure with smooth, minimal strokes. Over time, a faint glow rises from the line drawing; black lines gradually fill with realistic skin texture and clothing color, presenting a smooth transition from sketch to real person. The figure begins to shift from a static standing pose, subtle movement in the shoulders. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000 [3-6s] 【ACTION】The fully materialized real person begins walking forward naturally. The camera maintains a fixed position. The person's gait is relaxed and confident, arms swinging gently. Clothing wrinkles and fabric movement are realistic.【/ACTION】 Lighting stays consistent with the line art's original composition, softly illuminating the figure and its clothing folds. The overall color palette transitions from line-art monochrome to natural tones.

overall_soundscape: Initial faint magical shimmer and air flow, transitioning to clear rhythmic footsteps on solid ground, subtle clothing rustle, and calm breathing.

non_diegetic_music: A light ambient electronic track with slow tempo, soft synth pads, and minimal percussion, creating a calm and hopeful atmosphere.

templates.name: 线稿转彩色动画
templates.description: 线稿角色逐渐上色为彩色动画风格并开始动作
templates.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-3s] The frame opens with a clean black-and-white line-art character on a white background. The line work is crisp with anime-style proportions. Gradually, color bleeds into the lines from bottom to top — first the clothing fills with vibrant anime colors, then skin tone, then hair color. The transition is smooth and magical, like ink spreading on wet paper. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000 [3-6s] 【ACTION】The fully colored anime character comes alive. Hair flows gently as if blown by a breeze. The character blinks once, then turns to face the camera with a subtle smile.【/ACTION】 A few particles of light float around the character. The background shifts from pure white to a soft pastel gradient. Camera holds steady in a medium shot.

overall_soundscape: Soft magical chimes during the coloring phase, transitioning to a gentle breeze sound and subtle fabric movement as the character animates.

non_diegetic_music: A cheerful anime-style background track with light piano and strings, playful and uplifting melody, moderate tempo.

templates.name: 线稿转3D立体模型
templates.description: 2D线稿逐步转化为3D立体模型并旋转展示
templates.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-3s] A 2D black-and-white line-art object is displayed centered on a neutral gray background. The line work is technical and precise. Gradually, the flat lines begin to extrude and acquire depth — surfaces develop shading, highlights, and material properties. The transformation is smooth, as if a 2D blueprint is inflating into a full 3D model. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000 [3-6s] The fully formed 3D model begins a slow 360-degree rotation on the Y-axis. Camera is fixed. Realistic materials are visible — metallic reflections, matte surfaces, or glass transparency depending on the object. Professional studio lighting from three angles creates clean highlights and shadows. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000 [6-8s] The rotation completes and the model settles to its original front-facing position. A subtle ambient occlusion pass enhances depth perception.

overall_soundscape: A low mechanical hum during the extrusion phase, soft servo-like sounds during rotation, and ambient studio room tone throughout.

non_diegetic_music: A minimalist electronic ambient track with deep bass and sparse high-frequency textures, evoking a high-tech design laboratory atmosphere.

templates.name: 肖像照转说话视频
templates.description: 人物肖像照活化，开始自然说话，唇形同步
templates.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced. Preserve the exact facial identity, hairstyle, and clothing from the reference image. The person's environment, background, and lighting from <Picture 1> are preserved throughout.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-6s] Live-action, cinematic. A medium-close shot frames the person from <Picture 1> in the original setting and lighting of the reference image. The camera is static at eye level. 【ACTION】The person initially has a calm, neutral expression, then begins to speak naturally. Their lips move in perfect sync with the dialogue. Eye contact is natural, occasionally glancing aside as if in conversation. Subtle head movements, blinks, and micro-expressions convey engagement.【/ACTION】 The person (S1) says a short, natural, friendly line (the exact words can be set by the user): <d>[Chinese] 你好，很高兴认识你。</d> Shallow depth of field keeps the subject sharp against the preserved background.

overall_soundscape: Soft indoor room ambience consistent with the reference image, subtle clothing rustle, and natural breathing between words.

non_diegetic_music: N/A — naturalistic scene with only ambient sounds.

templates.name: 全身照转动作视频
templates.description: 人物全身照活化，从静止到自然行走或运动
templates.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced. Preserve the exact identity, hairstyle, clothing, and body proportions from the reference image. The person's environment and lighting from <Picture 1> are preserved throughout.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-3s] Live-action, cinematic, a wide shot establishes the person from <Picture 1> standing in the original setting of the reference image. The camera is at eye level, slightly low angle. 【ACTION】The person initially stands still, then shifts weight to one leg, preparing to move. Natural movement continues as in the reference. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000 [3-6s] The person begins walking forward at a natural pace toward the camera. The camera slowly tracks backward to maintain framing. Gait is confident and relaxed, arms swinging naturally. Footsteps land on the ground with realistic physics. The person smiles subtly as they walk.【/ACTION】 Background elements pass by with natural parallax. Lighting stays consistent with the reference image.

overall_soundscape: Natural ambience consistent with the reference image, rhythmic footsteps on the ground, and clothing movement.

non_diegetic_music: A light, uplifting acoustic guitar melody at moderate tempo, evoking a carefree outdoor stroll.

templates.name: 角色定转展示
templates.description: 角色从正面到背面的360度转身展示
templates.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced. Preserve the exact identity, hairstyle, clothing, and proportions from the reference image. The background and lighting from <Picture 1> are preserved.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-8s] Live-action, cinematic. A full-body shot frames the person from <Picture 1> standing in the original setting of the reference image. The camera is fixed at eye level with a slight low angle. 【ACTION】The person begins a slow, deliberate 360-degree turn on the spot. First the front, then the right side, then the back, then the left side, returning to front-facing. The turn is smooth and continuous at a steady pace. Hair and clothing react naturally to the rotation.【/ACTION】 Lighting stays consistent with the reference image, keeping the subject clearly visible throughout the turn. Shallow depth of field keeps the subject sharp against the background.

overall_soundscape: Subtle room tone consistent with the reference image, gentle clothing rustle during the turn, and soft footsteps as weight shifts.

non_diegetic_music: A minimal ambient track with slow, sustained synth notes, creating a professional fashion showcase atmosphere.

templates.prompt:

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-8s] Commercial product showcase. The product from <Picture 1> is centered on a clean, uncluttered studio background consistent with the reference. The camera is fixed at a three-quarter angle, eye-level with the product. The product begins a slow, smooth 360-degree rotation on a turntable. integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-4s] Cinematic commercial. The product from <Picture 1> is placed in a clean, tasteful lifestyle setting consistent with the mood of the reference image. Natural soft lighting matches the reference. The camera slowly pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the product. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000 [4-7s] A hand enters frame from the right and gently picks up the product. The hand interaction is natural and realistic. The camera follows the product as it is lifted. templates.description: 静态风景图变为航拍穿越飞行的动态视频
templates.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-10s] Cinematic aerial shot. The landscape from <Picture 1> comes alive as the camera begins a smooth forward tracking shot at moderate speed, as if flying over the scene. The camera descends gradually from an elevated position, gliding over foreground elements. Wind moves trees, grass, and water surfaces naturally. Clouds drift slowly in the sky. Birds may be seen flying in the distance. The time of day and lighting from the reference image are preserved. As the camera advances, new landscape details beyond the original frame are revealed — extending the scene naturally. The motion is smooth, continuous, and physically believable. Photorealistic quality with natural atmospheric haze.

overall_soundscape: Wind rushing past, distant bird calls, rustling foliage, and ambient nature sounds.

non_diegetic_music: An epic cinematic orchestral track with soaring strings and subtle brass, evoking a sense of wonder and exploration.

templates.name: 室内空间漫游
templates.description: 室内设计图变为第一人称漫游视频
templates.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-10s] First-person POV, eye-level. The interior space from <Picture 1> serves as the starting point. The camera begins a smooth forward dolly move, as if a person is walking through the space at a natural pace. The camera has subtle handheld sway — slight up-and-down and side-to-side movement synchronized with walking rhythm. As the camera moves forward, the original framing extends naturally — new walls, furniture, and architectural details beyond the original image come into view. Lighting shifts naturally as the viewpoint changes. Soft window light creates moving reflections on surfaces. The movement is continuous and physically believable, navigating through doorways or around furniture naturally.

overall_soundscape: Subtle footsteps on flooring, ambient room tone, distant environmental sounds, and soft clothing rustle.

non_diegetic_music: A calm ambient track with slow piano notes and soft electronic textures, creating a contemplative architectural atmosphere.

templates.name: 真人照片转日漫风格
templates.description: 真人照片逐步过渡为日式动画风格并开始动作
templates.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-3s] The frame begins with the photorealistic image from <Picture 1>. Subtle distortion begins at the edges — colors become slightly more saturated, lines sharpen. The transformation spreads inward from the frame edges: skin textures smooth into cel-shaded anime style, hair becomes more stylized with defined strands, eyes enlarge slightly and gain anime-style highlights. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000 [3-8s] The fully anime-styled character begins moving. Hair sways dramatically as if in strong wind. The character turns their head and blinks with exaggerated anime-style eye movements. Speed lines and sparkle effects appear briefly. The background has transformed into an anime-style painted background. The camera slowly pushes in. The overall aesthetic is consistent with high-quality Japanese anime production.

overall_soundscape: A soft whoosh during the style transition, then ambient anime-style sounds with wind and subtle movement sounds.

non_diegetic_music: An upbeat anime-style track with energetic synthesized strings and light percussion, evoking a slice-of-life anime atmosphere.

templates.name: 照片转水彩画
templates.description: 照片逐渐变为水彩画风格，画中元素开始流动
templates.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-3s] The photorealistic image from <Picture 1> begins to transform. Color bleeds and softens as if water is being applied to the frame. Edges blur and merge. The photorealistic detail gradually gives way to soft watercolor textures — visible paper grain, pigment bleeding, and wet-on-wet effects. The transformation is organic and flowing. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000 [3-8s] The fully watercolor-styled scene comes alive. Watercolor-painted elements begin subtle movement — a painted river flows, painted trees sway, painted clouds drift. The brushstrokes themselves seem to shift and re-flow. Camera slowly pulls out with small amplitude. The overall feel is of a living painting. Colors are soft and translucent with visible paper texture.

overall_soundscape: Soft ambient sounds of water, gentle brush-on-paper texture, and distant natural sounds appropriate to the scene.

non_diegetic_music: A gentle classical piano piece with soft, flowing arpeggios, evoking the feeling of watching paint dry and come alive.

templates.name: 照片转油画风格
templates.description: 照片转为油画厚涂风格，笔触可见，画面元素微动
templates.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-3s] The photorealistic image from <Picture 1> transforms into a rich oil painting style. Visible thick brushstrokes emerge across the frame — the Impasto technique. Colors become more saturated and layered. The transformation spreads from center outward. Textured canvas grain becomes visible. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000 [3-8s] The oil-painting scene gains subtle life. Painted elements move gently — painted foliage shifts, painted water ripples with visible brushstroke patterns. Light shifts across the textured paint surface, creating moving highlights on the raised impasto ridges. The camera slowly pushes in. The aesthetic is reminiscent of post-impressionist masters. Rich, warm color palette with visible paint layers.

overall_soundscape: Ambient sounds appropriate to the painted scene, with a subtle texture of brush on canvas as a background element.

non_diegetic_music: A classical orchestral track in the style of late romantic period composers, with rich strings and woodwinds, evoking a museum gallery atmosphere.

templates.name: 动漫图片转真人视频
templates.description: 动漫风格图片逐步转化为真人写实视频并自然动起来。【I2V图生视频模式，上传一张动漫图】。注：I2V模式会保持首帧风格，动漫转真人效果取决于原图风格化程度，建议先用风格较写实的动漫图测试。
templates.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-4s] The frame begins with the anime-style image from <Picture 1>. A photorealistic transformation begins at the edges of the frame and spreads inward toward the center. Cel-shaded colors shift into natural lifelike tones. Anime-style skin smooths into realistic human skin with natural texture and subtle pores. Oversized anime eyes adjust to natural human proportions while keeping the same eye color, shape, and expression. Stylized hair becomes real hair with individual strands and natural sheen. Clothing gains real fabric texture and proper folds. The flat anime background becomes a real environment with natural lighting and depth. The character's identity, hair color, eye color, outfit, pose, and composition are all preserved — it is the same person rendered in live-action realism. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000 [4-8s] The fully photorealistic character moves naturally. Hair sways softly in a light breeze. The character blinks naturally and makes a slight head turn. The chest rises and falls with calm breathing. Realistic light shifts across the skin and hair. The camera slowly pushes in slightly. The overall look is cinematic live-action realism — shallow depth of field, soft bokeh, professional portrait lighting, shot on an 85mm prime lens, natural color grading, 8K quality.

overall_soundscape: A soft whoosh during the style transition, then natural ambient sounds — gentle wind, subtle fabric rustle, quiet environmental atmosphere.

non_diegetic_music: A warm cinematic score that builds from soft piano during the transformation into lush strings, conveying the quiet wonder of a character stepping into reality.

templates.name: 种子破土开花
templates.description: 一颗种子在土壤中破土、发芽、抽茎、含苞、绽放为花朵的完整生长
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic macro time-lapse, fixed camera at a low angle close to dark, moist soil. A single brown seed rests on the soil surface at frame center. The seed coat cracks, a pale root tip pushes downward into the soil, and a tender pale-green shoot emerges upward, splitting open as two rounded cotyledon leaves unfold. The camera is static; the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a slightly wider angle. The stem lengthens and thickens rapidly, true leaves grow out and spread toward the light, and the plant rises through the center of the frame. Tiny water droplets glisten on the leaves. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up of the stem tip. A green bud swells, petals gradually unfurl from the tip outward, and the flower opens fully, revealing bright layered petals and a yellow center. The plant sways gently as if in a light breeze, and the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the fully opened bloom.

overall_soundscape: Soft soil shifting, the delicate rustle of leaves unfurling, a faint breeze, and a single low drone of ambient nature.

non_diegetic_music: A gentle piano arpeggio at a slow tempo with soft sustained strings that gradually swell as the flower opens, then fade to a quiet resolution.

templates.name: 藤蔓缠绕生长
templates.description: 藤蔓沿石墙或花架蜿蜒缠绕向上攀爬的延时生长
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed medium-wide shot of a garden trellis in soft daylight. A thin green vine at the base begins to extend upward, its tip curling and searching in small circles. The camera is static; the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a closer framing following the vine tip. The vine grows steadily upward, tendrils wrapping around the trellis posts and stone edges, small heart-shaped leaves sprouting along the stem in rapid succession, each leaf unfolding as it emerges. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot of the upper trellis. The vine reaches the top and spreads sideways, covering the trellis with dense green foliage, a few small flowers budding and opening among the leaves. Soft daylight rakes across the leaves, and the camera tilts up slowly as the vine completes its climb.

overall_soundscape: Gentle wind through leaves, the soft rasp of tendrils brushing stone, distant birdsong, and a quiet natural ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A light acoustic guitar pattern at a moderate tempo with soft woodwind accompaniment, warm and organic, ending on a calm held note.

templates.name: 蘑菇破土生长
templates.description: 森林地面上一丛蘑菇破土而出、菌盖撑开的微距延时
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic macro time-lapse, a low fixed camera close to a forest floor. The soil surface shows a faint crack in the center; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a tighter macro angle. Small white mushroom caps push up through the soil and leaf litter, their stems elongating as the caps rise, lifting fallen leaves aside. The caps swell and round out, gills visible beneath the edges. [Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a wider low angle. A cluster of mushrooms stands fully grown at different heights, their caps unfurling like small umbrellas, morning dew beading on the caps. A single ray of light falls on the tallest mushroom, and the camera pushes in slowly with small amplitude.

overall_soundscape: The soft crackle of soil and leaves parting, a faint damp forest ambience, dripping water, and a low rustle of wind in the canopy.

non_diegetic_music: A sparse, gentle piano motif at a slow tempo with soft ambient pads, quiet and earthy, fading to near silence at the end.

templates.name: 大树四季生长
templates.description: 一株树苗长成参天大树，并经历春夏秋冬四季轮回
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed wide shot of an open meadow under a large sky. A small sapling with a few leaves stands at frame center; the camera is static, the frame never moves. The sapling grows taller and thicker in fast motion, branches spreading outward as the seasons cycle. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a medium-wide angle. Spring arrives: the tree bursts into fresh green leaves, pink blossom clusters bloom and fall. The camera remains still. Summer follows as the canopy thickens into deep green. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a wider view. Autumn colors wash over the leaves from green to gold to red, and the leaves drift down in spirals; then winter comes, bare branches gather frost and snow, and the ground turns white. [Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to a full wide shot. The mature tree stands in a fresh spring once more, covered in new green leaves, clouds racing across the sky behind it, and the camera slowly pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed to reveal the whole tree against the landscape.

overall_soundscape: Wind in changing seasons, rustling leaves, drifting snow, birdsong in spring, and a continuous low ambient drone.

non_diegetic_music: A lyrical string-and-piano theme at a slow tempo that changes texture with each season, ending on a warm, resolved chord.

templates.name: 破茧成蝶
templates.description: 毛毛虫结茧、化蛹、破茧而出展翅成蝶的完整蜕变
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic macro time-lapse, a fixed close-up of a green leaf on a sunlit branch. A striped caterpillar crawls across the leaf, then hangs upside down and spins a silken thread around itself, gradually forming a smooth chrysalis. The camera is static; the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a tighter macro angle on the chrysalis. The chrysalis darkens and begins to crack along its back; the crack widens slowly as a damp, crumpled head and antennae push out. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a side close-up. A butterfly emerges, clinging to the empty shell, its soft wet wings slowly unfurling and straightening, wing patterns and colors deepening as they dry. [Shot 4] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to a wider angle. The butterfly spreads its fully dried wings wide, then lifts off the branch and flutters away into warm backlit forest air, and the camera tracks it briefly before holding on the empty chrysalis.

overall_soundscape: Gentle breeze, the faint rasp of silk and cracking shell, soft wing beats as the butterfly flies away, and warm forest ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A delicate harp and flute melody at a slow tempo, airy and bright, swelling gently as the butterfly takes flight and resolving softly.

templates.name: 蝌蚪变青蛙
templates.description: 蝌蚪在水塘中长腿、蜕尾、变态为青蛙并跃上陆地
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed underwater medium shot in a clear shallow pond. A cluster of dark tadpoles with small tails swims among green water plants near the surface; the camera is static, the frame never moves. The tadpoles grow slowly, hind legs budding and lengthening behind their bodies. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a closer underwater angle. The tadpoles develop front legs, their tails slowly shrink and are absorbed into their bodies, and their bodies change from round to a sleeker frog shape. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a low angle at the water surface. Young frogs climb onto a lily pad and a muddy bank at the pond edge, their skin darkening to green-brown with spots, and one frog takes a first short hop. [Shot 4] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to a wider shot of the bank. The frog leaps from the bank onto a stone and then out of frame into tall grass, leaving ripples on the water, and the camera holds on the quiet pond.

overall_soundscape: Underwater bubbling, water ripples and splashes, soft croaks, and a calm pond ambience with distant birds.

non_diegetic_music: A light, playful woodwind and pizzicato strings piece at a moderate tempo, gentle and bouncy, ending with a soft chord.

templates.name: 破壳雏鸟成长
templates.description: 鸟蛋破壳、雏鸟进食、羽毛长全后展翅离巢
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed close-up of a small nest of twigs and moss holding three pale blue eggs, in a tree at golden morning light. A small crack appears on one egg and slowly widens; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a slightly wider angle. A wet chick breaks the shell open, tumbles out, and huddles in the nest as its siblings hatch, all three gaping for food; a parent bird briefly lands to feed them. The chicks grow quickly, grey down replacing with small feathers. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up. The young birds are fully feathered and flutter their wings on the nest rim, testing balance, wings beating fast. [Shot 4] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to a wide shot of the branch and sky. One by one the young birds leap from the nest and glide clumsily out of frame into the open sky, and the camera holds on the empty nest swaying gently.

overall_soundscape: Soft tapping and cracking of shells, high-pitched cheeping, rapid wing beats, and a bright morning forest ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A cheerful flute and light strings melody at a moderate tempo, bright and hopeful, ending as the birds fly off.

templates.name: 幼犬成长
templates.description: 一只幼犬从出生到长大成犬的成长延时，同一视角
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed medium shot of a cozy wooden-floored room corner with a soft blanket. A tiny newborn puppy with closed eyes lies curled on the blanket; the camera is static, the frame never moves. The puppy wriggles and slowly opens its eyes, ears beginning to lift. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to the same framing slightly wider. The puppy grows through fast motion, learning to stand on wobbly legs, taking clumsy first steps, its paws and body enlarging, short fur thickening. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a medium-wide shot. The now larger puppy runs playfully in a circle on the floor, tail wagging, tongue out, before sitting and looking up at the camera with bright eyes. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of the grown dog's face. It tilts its head, blinks once, and gives a happy open-mouth pant, soft window light on its fur, and the camera pushes in very slightly.

overall_soundscape: Soft whimpers, the patter of paws on wood, gentle panting, a tail thumping, and a warm indoor room tone.

non_diegetic_music: A warm, simple ukulele and light percussion track at a moderate tempo, cheerful and cozy, ending with a gentle strum.

subcategories.name: 人物生长类
subcategories.description: 人物从婴儿、少年到成年、暮年的成长与变化

templates.name: 婴儿到成人
templates.description: 同一个婴儿在连续镜头中成长为青年，五官特征全程保持
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Photorealistic, front-facing portrait, a static medium close-up. A newborn baby lies against a plain, warm, neutral background, eyes gently opening. The camera is static; the frame never moves. The person grows seamlessly and continuously in one take: becoming a chubby toddler with the same face shape, then a school-age child, then a teenager, then a young adult, the same face shape and soft expression preserved at every age, the overall look developing naturally over time. [Shot 2] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. The person is now fully grown, gentle smile, the plain neutral background unchanged, soft even light, slow seamless aging transition, front-facing portrait framing throughout. [Shot 3] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to a very slight close-up on the face. The person blinks slowly, smiles warmly at the camera, hair brushed by an unseen breeze, then the frame holds on the calm expression as the video ends.

overall_soundscape: A quiet, warm indoor tone with a very faint breeze, soft fabric movement, and gentle breathing.

non_diegetic_music: A tender piano and soft strings piece at a slow tempo, warm and nostalgic, ending on a sustained gentle note.

templates.name: 容颜老去
templates.description: 同一张正面肖像从青春到暮年逐渐老去，皱纹白发浮现
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Photorealistic, front-facing portrait, a static close-up of a person in their 20s with smooth skin, neutral studio lighting, plain grey background. The camera is static; the frame never moves. The face ages in slow seamless morph: skin texture gradually coarsens, fine lines deepen around the eyes and mouth, hair begins to grey at the temples. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. The person is now middle-aged: deeper wrinkles, greying hair, slightly softened jawline, the same eyes and nose structure clearly preserved. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. The person is now elderly: silver-white hair, pronounced wrinkles, gentle weathered skin, the same warm eyes and recognizable features still intact. The person blinks slowly and gives a soft, serene smile. [Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a very slight close-up on the face and holds; the person looks steadily at the camera, breathing softly, and the frame freezes on the face as the video ends.

overall_soundscape: A calm, quiet studio room tone with a faint low hum and soft breathing throughout.

non_diegetic_music: A sparse solo cello line at a slow tempo with soft piano chords, melancholic yet serene, resolving gently at the end.

templates.name: 一生旅程
templates.description: 一个人从婴儿到暮年的一生在连续横移镜头中展开
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, photorealistic, a continuous lateral tracking shot at a steady pace across a 15-second timeline. The camera glides smoothly from left to right with zero cuts as one person travels through every stage of life while the surrounding world seamlessly evolves in real time. The sequence begins on a newborn cradled in a parent's arms under soft light. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot transitions as the camera keeps moving right: the child grows into a toddler running through an open outdoor space, then a school-age child walking along a quiet street, the surroundings subtly changing with time. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot continues: the person is a young adult walking through an everyday urban area, then a middle-aged figure walking through the same area as the light turns golden, buildings and trees around them aging and changing with time. [Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the shot completes: the elderly person walks slowly toward a bench under a tree as dusk falls, sits down, and looks toward the camera with a peaceful smile, and the camera gently slows and holds on their face.

overall_soundscape: Shifting environmental ambience from nursery sounds to birdsong, city traffic, wind, and evening crickets, with steady footsteps throughout.

non_diegetic_music: A lyrical orchestral theme that evolves with each life stage, warm strings and piano, ending in a quiet, resolved cadence.

templates.name: 形象蜕变
templates.description: 同一人物从青涩到成熟、从旧我到新我的蜕变
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic portrait, a medium shot of a shy, casually dressed young person standing against a plain wall in muted light. The person looks down, then slowly lifts their head toward the camera; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. Time-lapse change sweeps over them: their look becomes neatly groomed, casual attire is replaced by formal attire, posture straightens, shoulders pull back, and the expression shifts from hesitant to calm and confident. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a closer medium shot. The person is now a poised professional in formal wear, standing in soft warm light, a subtle confident smile on their face, eyes steady. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of their face. The person turns slightly, adjusts their cuff, and looks directly into the camera with a composed, self-assured gaze, and the camera holds as the video ends.

overall_soundscape: Quiet indoor room tone, soft fabric rustle as clothes change, a faint heartbeat-like pulse, and steady breathing.

non_diegetic_music: A modern cinematic track that builds from sparse piano to fuller strings and soft percussion as the transformation unfolds, ending on a confident resolved chord.

subcategories.name: 物体生长类
subcategories.description: 建筑、城市、水晶等非生命体的生长与扩张过程

templates.name: 水晶簇生长
templates.description: 岩洞中水晶簇从微小晶芽快速生长成巨大晶体的延时
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic macro time-lapse inside a dark cave, a fixed close-up of a rocky wall pocket. Tiny glassy crystal nubs begin to appear on the rock surface; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a tighter angle. The crystals lengthen and thicken rapidly in fast motion, faceted prisms pushing outward at different angles, catching faint blue cave light and sparkling. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up. A dense cluster of large translucent crystals fills the pocket, their sharp tips glinting, a thin film of water shimmering over their surfaces. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a wider low angle. The full crystal cluster gleams in a shaft of pale light from above, and the camera pushes in slowly with small amplitude.

overall_soundscape: A resonant cavern ambience, faint crystalline chimes as the crystals form, and a low echoing drip of water.

non_diegetic_music: A minimalist ambient track with shimmering high bell tones and deep sustained pads, mysterious and crystalline, fading quietly.

templates.name: 城市扩张生长
templates.description: 一片空地快速生长出完整现代城市的延时航拍
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic aerial time-lapse, a high fixed vantage point above an empty flat parcel of land bordered by farmland and a river; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to the same aerial framing. Road grids appear first, then foundations and building skeletons rise rapidly, cranes moving in fast motion, streets filling with tiny vehicles. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a slightly lower aerial angle. Towering glass buildings complete, parks and plazas fill in with trees, and the district becomes a dense modern city center. [Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to a wide aerial view at dusk. The completed city lights turn on building by building, traffic light trails stream along the roads, and the camera slowly pulls out and rises to reveal the whole glowing district against the darkening landscape.

overall_soundscape: Distant construction clatter and cranes, faint traffic rumble, wind over the city, and a low urban ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A modern orchestral build with steady percussion and rising strings, optimistic and expansive, ending in a bright full chord.

categories.name: 延时摄影类

subcategories.name: 建筑延时类
subcategories.description: 建筑从地基到竣工、城市昼夜交替等延时效果

templates.name: 摩天楼拔地而起
templates.description: 一座摩天大楼从基坑到封顶的完整施工延时
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic aerial time-lapse, a high-angle view of a deep excavation pit in a dense downtown district. Yellow tower cranes swing steel beams into place rhythmically against a backdrop of existing glass skyscrapers; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to the same aerial angle. The building skeleton rises rapidly floor by floor, concrete cores and steel frames growing upward, cranes climbing alongside, workers and machinery moving in fast motion. The sunlight cycle shifts from dawn to golden hour to deep blue twilight. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a closer diagonal angle. The tower tops out and glass curtain walls are installed section by section, the facade becoming a reflective skin of windows. [Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a low upward angle. The completed skyscraper stands against a twilight sky, windows lighting up from lower to upper floors, and the camera executes a slow, stabilized push-in toward the central structure.

overall_soundscape: Distant crane machinery, rhythmic steel clangs, wind around the tower, and a low urban construction ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A modern epic orchestral track with steady percussion and brass, building to a triumphant peak as the tower completes, then resolving.

templates.name: 城市昼夜交替
templates.description: 同一城市天际线从清晨到夜晚的光影变换延时
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed wide shot of a modern city skyline with tall skyscrapers, pre-dawn blue hour. The sky brightens as the sun rises behind the towers; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. Bright daylight floods the scene, clouds race across the sky, shadows sweep across the buildings as the sun arcs overhead. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. Golden hour sunset washes the towers in warm orange light, then the light fades into deep blue twilight. [Shot 4] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to the same framing at night. Windows light up one by one across the skyline, neon and street lights glow, and light trails from moving traffic streak along the streets below; the camera slowly pushes in with very small amplitude.

overall_soundscape: A low urban hum, distant traffic, wind over the towers, and a gradual shift from birdsong at dawn to city night ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A smooth ambient electronic track with soft pads and gentle pulse, evolving in warmth through the day cycle, ending on a calm night chord.

templates.name: 室内装修延时
templates.description: 一间毛坯房从空壳到精装完成的全过程延时
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed wide shot of an empty concrete room with bare walls, a window at the far end, and daylight entering; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. Scaffolding appears, workers move in fast motion, drywall partitions rise, plumbing and electrical conduits are installed, and plaster coats the walls. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. Flooring is laid, walls are painted, cabinetry and light fixtures are mounted, and furniture is moved in piece by piece, the room filling with a warm interior. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a slightly lower angle. The finished room is complete with soft furnishings, warm lamps glowing, and a view of dusk through the window; the camera pushes in slowly with small amplitude toward the lit interior.

overall_soundscape: Rapid construction noises, hammering, sawing, footsteps, and a gradual transition to a quiet, cozy indoor room tone.

non_diegetic_music: A light acoustic track with gentle guitar and soft percussion, upbeat and satisfying, ending on a warm settled note.

templates.name: 跨海大桥合龙
templates.description: 跨海大桥从桥墩到桥面合龙的宏伟施工延时
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic aerial time-lapse, a wide view of a sea strait with massive bridge piers rising from the water in a long row; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a closer aerial angle along the piers. Tower cranes and gantries lift massive steel girder segments into place, the deck extending section by section across the water, ships passing beneath. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a low side angle near the gap. The final deck segments are lifted and fitted, the two ends meeting in a precise closure at the center of the span. [Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a wide aerial view at sunset. The completed bridge spans the strait, cables taut and lights switching on along the deck as dusk falls, and the camera slowly pulls back to reveal the full scale.

overall_soundscape: Heavy machinery, metallic clangs, wind over open water, lapping waves, and a low distant hum of the structure.

non_diegetic_music: A grand orchestral piece with brass and strings, steady and monumental, swelling as the bridge completes and resolving majestically.

subcategories.name: 产品组装延时类
subcategories.description: 产品爆炸图组装、3D打印、精密部件装配等延时动画

templates.name: 产品爆炸图组装
templates.description: 一件产品从爆炸分解状态逐层合拢组装成完整成品
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 3D product visualization, a fixed medium shot on a clean white studio background with soft directional shadows. A modern wireless speaker hangs in exploded-view: its outer casing, grille, driver, circuit board, and base plate are separated along their axes, floating in space. The camera is static; the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. The inner circuit board moves inward and seats onto the base, then the driver lowers into the chassis, each part gliding along its axis in sequence. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a slightly tighter angle. The grille and outer casing close over the internal parts, the shell snapping shut with a satisfying fit, seams aligning perfectly. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a three-quarter angle. The fully assembled speaker rotates slowly 180 degrees on a turntable, every surface clean and sharp, and the camera pushes in slightly to showcase the finished product.

overall_soundscape: Soft mechanical clicks as parts seat together, a faint whir of the turntable, and a quiet clean studio tone.

non_diegetic_music: A modern minimal electronic track with crisp synth pulses and light percussion, precise and premium, ending on a clean resolved note.

templates.name: 3D打印成形
templates.description: 3D打印机逐层打印出一件立体物品的全过程延时
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic macro, a fixed medium close-up of a 3D printer nozzle above an empty build plate in a softly lit workshop; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a side angle through the printer frame. The nozzle moves back and forth rapidly, laying down fine layers of material that stack upward, the object taking shape layer by layer, thin filament lines visible on the surface. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a closer angle on the growing object. A detailed geometric sculpture emerges, its layers smoothing as the print nears completion, the nozzle making a final pass. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a medium shot. The print head lifts away and the completed object stands on the build plate; the plate lowers and the object is revealed fully formed, and the camera arcs slowly around it.

overall_soundscape: The rhythmic whir and click of the printer head, a soft electric hum, and a quiet workshop room tone.

non_diegetic_music: A minimalist electronic track with repeating arpeggios and soft beats, methodical and precise, ending with a clean final chord.

templates.name: 智能手表组装
templates.description: 智能手表的精密零件逐一组装成整机的工业延时
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic industrial visualization, a fixed close-up on a clean assembly surface under bright even light. The internal components of a smartwatch — screen module, battery, main board, sensors, and case — lie arranged and separated; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a tighter macro angle. The main board is placed into the case, the battery seats beside it, flex cables connect, and the sensor array clicks into position, each micro-part guided by robotic precision. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up. The display module presses down onto the case and seals seamlessly, the crown and button insert into the side. [Shot 4] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to a three-quarter angle. The finished smartwatch lies on the surface, screen briefly lighting up with a glowing watch face before dimming, and the camera pushes in slowly.

overall_soundscape: Delicate mechanical clicks, soft servo whirs, a faint electronic chime as the screen lights up, and a clean lab room tone.

non_diegetic_music: A refined electronic track with soft plucks and gentle percussion, sleek and modern, ending on a subtle ambient note.

templates.name: 积木拼搭延时
templates.description: 彩色积木从零散零件到搭建成完整模型的全过程
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic stop-motion-style time-lapse, a fixed wide shot of a clean white table with scattered colorful building blocks; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a slightly lower angle. Blocks lift and snap together by themselves in fast motion, forming a sturdy base platform, walls rising brick by brick. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a closer angle. Windows, a roof, and a small tower are added, the colorful model taking on the shape of a tiny house with a garden of green blocks. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a medium-wide shot. The completed block house stands on the table in bright natural light, and the camera arcs slowly around it before settling on the front view.

overall_soundscape: Sharp plastic clicks as blocks snap together, a soft thump as layers settle, and a bright playful room tone.

non_diegetic_music: A cheerful plucky melody with light xylophone and percussion, playful and upbeat, ending on a happy resolved note.

templates.name: 高速车流光轨
templates.description: 夜间高速公路上车流拉出红白光轨的延时
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a high elevated fixed angle above a multi-lane highway curving through a city at night; the camera is static, the frame never moves. Streams of cars move in both directions, their headlights and taillights stretching into continuous red and white light trails. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a slightly lower elevated angle. Traffic thickens and the light trails become longer and brighter, curving along the highway like ribbons of light, cars blinking past in streaks. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a closer high angle near an interchange. Multiple streams of light trails merge and split across stacked ramps, creating a glowing network against the dark city. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a wide aerial view. The full highway network glows with moving light trails under the night sky, and the camera slowly pulls out to reveal the scale.

overall_soundscape: A low continuous rush of traffic, distant engine hum, wind over the elevated viewpoint, and a subtle city night ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A smooth electronic ambient track with slow bass pulse and soft pads, sleek and nocturnal, ending on a lingering synth note.

templates.name: 立交桥车流
templates.description: 高空俯视复杂立交桥上川流不息的车流延时
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic aerial time-lapse, a high vertical top-down view of a complex multi-level interchange with curving ramps and overpasses; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to the same top-down framing. Vehicles stream continuously along every ramp and road, tiny cars in dense lines, merging and diverging through the loops in fast motion. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a slightly tilted aerial angle. The sun lowers and long shadows stretch across the interchange, traffic remaining steady, headlights beginning to switch on. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to the top-down view at dusk. The interchange lights up, headlight and taillight trails forming bright ribbons that trace every curve, and the camera slowly zooms in on the central hub.

overall_soundscape: A low continuous traffic drone, tire hum, wind over the elevated structure, and a faint distant city noise.

non_diegetic_music: A minimalist electronic piece with a steady pulse and airy pads, flowing and precise, ending on a calm sustained note.

templates.name: 地铁站人流
templates.description: 地铁站内密集人流如潮水般流动的延时
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed wide shot from a high corner of a modern subway station hall, escalators and platforms visible below; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a similar wide angle. Crowds of commuters flow through the hall like currents, streams moving in opposite directions, trains arriving and doors opening to release and swallow passengers in fast motion. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a closer elevated angle above an escalator bank. A dense continuous stream of people ascends and descends, the flow never stopping, their movements blurred by speed. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a wide shot of the platform edge. A train glides in, the crowd surges and parts, doors close, and the train departs leaving the platform briefly emptier; the camera holds as another train approaches.

overall_soundscape: Station announcements in the distance, train rumble and brakes, doors chime, a constant murmur of footsteps and voices.

non_diegetic_music: A driving modern electronic track with a steady pulse and light percussion, energetic and urban, ending on a clean cutoff.

templates.name: 港口货轮进出
templates.description: 集装箱港口货轮装卸、进出港的繁忙延时
templates.prompt:

A hand slams the table. The unseen interrogator (S2) says in an off-screen voiceover, a short pressure line (the exact words can be set by the user): <d>[Chinese] 再想想。你还有最后一次机会。</d> The lamp swings slightly from the impact, making shadows shift dramatically.

overall_soundscape: Dripping water echoing in a large room, chair creaking, table slam, cigarette burning, and heavy breathing.

templates.name: 四季变换延时

templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-12s] Cinematic timelapse. A single tree in a grassy field undergoes all four seasons in rapid succession. [0-3s] Spring: bare branches bud with fresh green leaves, grass turns vibrant green, cherry blossoms bloom around the base, light is soft and fresh. [3-6s] Summer: the tree is in full leaf, deep green canopy, grass is tall and lush, warm golden light, butterflies and dragonflies flit through the frame. [6-9s] Autumn: leaves turn from green to gold, orange, and red, then begin to fall — swirling in the wind, grass browns and dries, light becomes amber and low. [9-12s] Winter: the tree is bare, snow falls and accumulates on branches and ground, the scene is monochrome white and grey, cold blue light. The transitions between seasons are smooth — one morphs into the next with visible changes spreading across the frame. The camera is fixed throughout.

overall_soundscape: Wind sounds that change character with each season — gentle spring breeze, warm summer gust, autumn leaf-rustle wind, and cold winter howl. Bird songs in spring and summer, silence in winter.

non_diegetic_music: A contemplative piano piece that shifts in key and mood with each season — light and hopeful in spring, warm and full in summer, melancholic in autumn, and sparse and crystalline in winter.

templates.name: 时间穿越隧道

The person turns to look at the portal. Fragments of different time periods are visible in the tunnel walls — Roman columns, medieval castles, modern skyscrapers, future cityscapes — all distorted and flowing. The tunnel converges to a single bright point of light that fills the frame.

overall_soundscape: A building wind sound, crystalline chimes, distorted echoes of different historical sounds (chariots, swords, trains, rockets), and a rising sonic whoosh that peaks at the moment of entry.

non_diegetic_music: An electronic track with pulsing arpeggios that accelerate throughout, building from ambient to intense, with a massive crescendo at the moment of portal entry.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-4s] The frame begins with the anime-style image from <Picture 1>. A photorealistic transformation begins at the edges of the frame and spreads inward toward the center. Cel-shaded colors shift into natural lifelike tones. Anime-style skin smooths into realistic human skin with natural texture and subtle pores. Oversized anime eyes adjust to natural human proportions while keeping the same eye color, shape, and expression. Stylized hair becomes real hair with individual strands and natural sheen. Clothing gains real fabric texture and proper folds. The flat anime background becomes a real environment with natural lighting and depth. The character's identity, hair color, eye color, outfit, pose, and composition are all preserved — it is the same person rendered in live-action realism. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000 [4-8s] The fully photorealistic character moves naturally. Hair sways softly in a light breeze. The character blinks naturally and makes a slight head turn. The chest rises and falls with calm breathing. Realistic light shifts across the skin and hair. The camera slowly pushes in slightly. The overall look is cinematic live-action realism — shallow depth of field, soft bokeh, professional portrait lighting, shot on an 85mm prime lens, natural color grading, 8K quality.

overall_soundscape: A soft whoosh during the style transition, then natural ambient sounds — gentle wind, subtle fabric rustle, quiet environmental atmosphere.

non_diegetic_music: A warm cinematic score that builds from soft piano during the transformation into lush strings, conveying the quiet wonder of a character stepping into reality.

templates.name: 动漫转真人
templates.description:
将动漫/插画角色转换为超写实真人照片，保留构图与角色特征，极致真实皮肤纹理与自然人体比例。

【重要：本模板必须使用「参考生视频 (Reference to Video)」模式，上传两张图】
  • Picture 1 = 动漫图（提供内容、构图、姿势、服装布局）
  • Picture 2 = 真人图（提供脸部身份、皮肤纹理、真人风格基准）

【使用说明 — 三种生成模式】

▎模式1：文生视频 (Text to Video)
• 无需上传图片，纯靠文字描述生成真人视频
• 在"补充修改"中描述角色外貌、服装、场景和动作
• 效果：角色外观由文字决定，不是从特定动漫图转换

▎模式2：图生视频 (Image to Video) ⚠️ 不推荐用于完全转真人
• 上传动漫图片作为第一帧
• 效果有限！I2V会强烈保持第一帧的动漫风格，很难完全转为真人
• 仅用于让动漫图轻微动起来，不建议用于完全的动漫转真人

▎模式3：参考生视频 (Reference to Video) ✅ 【推荐】真正实现动漫转真人
• 上传两张参考图：
  - Picture 1 = 动漫图（内容/构图/姿势/服装参考）
  - Picture 2 = 真人图（脸部身份/皮肤纹理/风格基准）
• 效果：最好！以动漫图内容为骨架，注入真人图脸部和写实风格
• 技巧：真人参考图尽量选择与动漫角色性别、年龄、发型相近的真人照片

【参数建议】
• 时长：3-6秒（短时长风格转换更稳定）
• 超分放大时请关闭人脸修复（face_restore=Off），避免逐帧修复导致鬼影闪烁
templates.generation_mode: Reference to Video (参考生视频)【必须双图】
templates.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> 是目标视频中的主要人物。其脸部五官、面部轮廓、皮肤质感与真人写实摄影风格直接来自 <Picture 2>。其身体结构、姿势、服装款式、发型轮廓、场景布局与构图来自 <Picture 1>，全部以 <Picture 2> 的真人写实摄影风格重新呈现。头发必须呈现自然质感，服装必须呈现真实织物的物理质感，不得保留任何动漫渲染、3D建模或塑料光泽特征。
<Picture 1> 是动漫/插画风格内容参考图，提供人物身份、姿势、服装、构图与场景布局参考，其动漫艺术风格必须完全转换为真人写实风格。
<Picture 2> 是真人脸部锚定图与写实风格基准图，提供 <Subject 1> 的五官特征、皮肤纹理与摄影质感基准。其自身的构图、姿势、服装与背景不得被引用。

summary:
[reference generation] 目标视频是一段真人写实影像。视频以 <Picture 1> 的构图与内容为骨架，将 <Picture 2> 的真人脸部与写实摄影风格注入其中，生成一段固定镜头视频。

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - 脸部五官与皮肤质感来自 <Picture 2> 并被完全保留；身体结构、姿势、服装、构图与场景来自 <Picture 1> 并以写实风格重新渲染，不保留动漫特征。
<Picture 1> (内容与构图参考): strong_reference - 人物身份、姿势、服装、构图与场景布局被参考，动漫风格被完全转换为真人写实风格。
<Picture 2> (脸部锚定与风格基准): reference - 提供五官特征、皮肤纹理与写实摄影质感基准，其自身构图/姿势/服装/背景不被引用。

detailed_description:
目标视频采用超写实真人电影摄影风格，使用 50mm 定焦镜头拍摄，f/2.8 光圈，浅景深，自然色彩分级无滤镜感，8K UHD RAW 直出画质，零后期修图痕迹。画面构图与 <Picture 1> 完全一致：人物位置、身体角度、视线方向、服装款式、发型轮廓、场景空间布局严格保留 <Picture 1>。人物脸部替换为 <Picture 2> 的真人五官与皮肤质感，整体以超写实真人电影摄影风格渲染。皮肤呈现真实毛孔、细微瑕疵、皮下血管色调、自然油脂光泽、真实肤色过渡——绝对禁止光滑塑料感动漫皮肤。眼睛大小自然（禁止动漫大眼），虹膜细节真实，角膜反射自然，睫毛自然。鼻子立体有软骨结构与鼻翼定义，嘴唇真实纹理与唇红缘、自然湿度。毛发呈现每根发丝质感、自然毛躁与飞碎发、柔和方向光泽，发色为自然人类发色（禁止二次元发色）。服装呈现真实织纹（棉质哑光/皮革光泽/牛仔纹理等）、自然褶皱与物理垂坠感、真实材质反光——绝对禁止赛璐珞平涂色块。背景环境呈现真实空间深度、自然大气透视与真实材质表面。自然方向光在皮肤、毛发与面料表面形成真实明暗过渡与高光。相机保持固定构图，带有微妙的手持呼吸感——极其轻微、无规律的画面微颤，幅度极小，不产生推镜、拉镜或任何机位位移。人物保持 <Picture 1> 的姿势，仅有自然呼吸胸口起伏、轻微眨眼、毛发与面料极轻微摆动。

overall_soundscape:
真实环境声，电影级现场录音质感，自然的环境氛围

non_diegetic_music:
克制的电影配乐，稀疏弦乐，真实感与沉稳基调

templates.prompt:

integrated_multimodal_description: [镜头1]【0-3秒】画面由输入的真人照片平滑转化为高质量动漫风格：真人的面部特征被保留并动漫化——保持脸型、五官比例、眼睛形状、鼻梁轮廓、嘴唇厚度、下颌线条等身份特征，同时转换为动漫风格的表现：大而明亮的动漫眼睛、清晰的高光与瞳孔细节、干净流畅的墨线轮廓、明快的赛璐珞平涂上色、鲜明的光影分区、鲜艳而统一的色彩。皮肤呈现动漫风格的光滑质感与柔和渐变，毛发呈现动漫风格的色块与高光线条。服装呈现动漫风格的简化色块与清晰褶皱线。整体为高质量日式动漫插画质感：干净的线条、明快的色彩、统一的色调、充满日本动画的经典美感。保留原图的主体结构、构图与比例，仅画面表现手法转为动漫风格。[镜头2]【3-6秒】主体动作延续：【ACTION】保持输入图像中主体的运动状态，在高质量动漫风格下自然流畅地展现，头发与衣物随动作产生动漫风格的动态线条与色块变化【/ACTION】。整段画面统一呈现高质量动漫风格，艺术质感一致。

non_diegetic_music: 轻快活泼的日系动漫配乐，节奏明快，充满青春气息
